answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce Com 2 , a benchmark designed specifically to assess the complex commonsense reasoning in advanced LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: multiple-choice and multi-select answers for complex commonsense reasoning tasks

answer_2.quote: For each task in Com 2 , we adopt accuracy to quantify the performance of each LLM.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to evaluate the quality of Com 2 . The details (such as the pay and agreements) of the human evaluation can be referred to Appendix B.
answer_4.guideline: By providing human annotators with the causal graphs, humans can achieve average accuracies of 92% and 90% for Com 2 -main and Com 2 -hard, respectively.
